The fundamental mathematical structure here is a verification of set inclusion within a high-dimensional feature space. We define the catalog requirement set C containing 35 distinct parameter names and the extractor output set E containing 39 keys. The critical invariant is C ⊆ E. If this inclusion fails, any missing parameter p ∈ C \ E triggers a default assignment x_p = 0.0 via bindings.get(p, 0.0). This creates a 'silent-zero' failure mode where complex reasoning entries evaluate on degenerate inputs without raising exceptions. The audit confirms C ⊆ E holds perfectly across all 12,304 entries, eliminating this entire class of silent failures. Furthermore, the difference set D = E \ C contains exactly 4 elements: {is_indoor, precip_prob, short_week, total_points}. Rather than being dead weight, D forms a disjoint control manifold feeding the router's regime-mask logic. This bifurcation—where C drives entry evaluation and D drives routing topology—ensures orthogonal functionality. The remaining epistemic gap lies downstream: whether these rigorously bound outputs successfully propagate to the published surface. Thus, the internal consumption chain is mathematically closed and robust, isolating potential system failures strictly to the external interface layer.
